name.en: One Stop Centre (Sakhi) & Working Women Hostel Support (WCD Delhi)

bilingual_title.hi: वन स्टॉप सेंटर (सखी) एवं कामकाजी महिला छात्रावास योजना

eligibility_criteria.domicile_ncr_rule: Women in distress within Delhi (Sakhi emergency); working women meeting hostel rules in Delhi [VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION].
eligibility_criteria.income_cap: ₹0 Sakhi emergency; hostel income/tariff per rules
eligibility_criteria.category_rules: All women in need of emergency protection or working accommodation.
eligibility_criteria.academic_or_work_rules: Employment proof required for Working Women Hostel.
eligibility_criteria.exclusions: Men (Sakhi is exclusively for women/children in distress).

benefit.summary_hi: हिंसा पीड़ित महिलाओं को सखी सेंटर में निःशुल्क आपात चिकित्सा, पुलिस व कानूनी सहायता तथा कामकाजी महिलाओं हेतु सुरक्षित हॉस्टल।
benefit.summary_en: Emergency medical, legal, police & counselling shelter at Sakhi centres; subsidised safe accommodation at Working Women Hostels [VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION].

benefit_summary.en: Emergency medical, legal, police & counselling shelter at Sakhi centres; subsidised safe accommodation at Working Women Hostels [VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION].
benefit_summary.hi: हिंसा पीड़ित महिलाओं को सखी सेंटर में निःशुल्क आपात चिकित्सा, पुलिस व कानूनी सहायता तथा कामकाजी महिलाओं हेतु सुरक्षित हॉस्टल।

application_steps.offline: Visit District Sakhi One Stop Centre or call Women Helpline 181.
application_steps.facilitation_center: Sakhi One Stop Centre / Helpline 181 / CFC

verification_note.hi: नोट ([VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION]): वर्तमान 2026–27 सक्रिय आवेदन विंडो, स्लैब व अंतिम नियम कृपया आधिकारिक सरकारी पोर्टल पर सत्यापित करें।
verification_note.en: Notice ([VERIFY LATEST NOTIFICATION]): Always verify active 2026–27 window, exact slab/amount, and current circular on the official portal before applying.

anti_dalal.official_fee: ₹0 for Sakhi emergency support; notified hostel tariff
anti_dalal.csc_fee_note_hi: सरकारी CFC या CSC केंद्र पर केवल निर्धारित सेवा शुल्क (₹0–₹50) व पक्की रसीद लागू
anti_dalal.csc_fee_note_en: Nominal authorized CFC/CSC facilitation fee only (always take printed receipt)
anti_dalal.receipt_rule: Always collect your official Acknowledgement Slip & Reference Number after submission. Never pay without a printed receipt.
anti_dalal.middleman_warning: Never pay agents/middlemen promising guaranteed approval or faster clearance. Benefits are disbursed strictly via DBT / official portals.
